name: profit_and_loss_summary
description: Income vs expense totals for a date range (default last month); NOI = Income total minus Expense total. Built-in ProfitLoss report.

property.description: Property name/nickname/ID, comma-separated for several; empty = all

basis.description: Cash or Accrual; empty = Rent Manager default (Cash)

show_hidden_rows.description: also show rows the report hides (HideRow = true); these are parent/subtotal rows, so sums and NOI double count

answer_hint: Quote the Answer line (NOI is already computed; do no arithmetic).
headline: NOI {noi$} for {start} to {end}: Income {income$} minus Expense {expense$} (other/non-operating types excluded).
